materials.name: LT_Terrain
materials.unity: URP Lit (opaque, metallic workflow). Base Map LT_Terrain_Macro (sRGB, Clamp) on UV0, tiling 1 1, colour white; Metallic 0; Smoothness 0.1; no base Normal Map. Detail Inputs: Mask none; Base Map LT_TerrainDetail_Albedo (sRGB, Repeat), scale 1; Normal Map LT_TerrainDetail_Normal (Texture Type Normal map, Repeat), scale 1; Tiling 1280 1280, Offset 0 0 (one 5 m tile).
materials.fallback: Tiled BaseMap only: Base Map LT_TerrainTile_BaseColor (sRGB, Repeat), Tiling 400 400 (one 16 m tile), colour white; Normal Map LT_TerrainDetail_Normal, scale 0.6 (same 16 m tiling); no Detail Inputs.

materials.name: LT_TerrainFar
materials.unity: URP Lit. Base Map LT_Terrain_Macro (the same texture asset, Clamp) on UV0, tiling 1 1, colour white; Metallic 0; Smoothness 0.08; no Normal Map, no Detail Inputs. The far ring's UV0 lies in the map's outer band.
materials.fallback: Base Map none, Base Color #7C7F57, Smoothness 0.08.

materials.name: LT_Rock
materials.unity: URP Lit with LAND's LS_Concrete maps (BaseColor sRGB, Normal, MODS: R metallic, G occlusion, A smoothness), Base Color #8C8579, tiling 0.5 per UV unit (UVs are world-scale, 1 UV = 1 m, so one tile is 2 m).
